Result

Result pages summarize the outcome of a completed action — a payment, a form submit, or a system error — with clear next steps.

Success Result

A positive outcome with action buttons for next steps.

Payment successful

Your invoice has been paid. A receipt has been sent to your email.

HTML
<div class="zak-result zak-result-success">
    <span class="zak-result-icon">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="width:4rem;height:4rem;">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M8 12l2.5 2.5L16 9"/>
        </svg>
    </span>
    <h2 class="zak-result-title">Payment successful</h2>
    <p class="zak-result-text">Your invoice has been paid.</p>
    <div class="zak-result-actions">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">View Invoice</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Back to Dashboard</button>
    </div>
</div>

Error Result

Communicate failure and the recovery path.

Payment failed

We couldn't process your payment. Check your details and try again.

HTML
<div class="zak-result zak-result-danger">
    <span class="zak-result-icon">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="width:4rem;height:4rem;">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M15 9l-6 6M9 9l6 6"/>
        </svg>
    </span>
    <h2 class="zak-result-title">Payment failed</h2>

</div>

Account verified

         color:var(--zak-color-success);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>
    </span>
    <h2 class="zak-result-title">Account verified</h2>
    <p class="zak-result-text">Your email address has been confirmed.</p>
    <div class="zak-result-actions">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Get Started</button>
    </div>
</div>

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-result           /* Centered column container */
.zak-result-success    /* Success icon color */
.zak-result-warning    /* Warning icon color */
.zak-result-danger     /* Danger icon color */
.zak-result-icon       /* Large icon */
.zak-result-title      /* Result heading */
.zak-result-text       /* Supporting description */
.zak-result-actions    /* Action button row */

Accessibility

  • Use a proper heading level that matches the page structure (<h1> for a standalone result page).
  • Decorative icons should be aria-hidden="true".
  • Announce dynamic result outcomes with aria-live="polite" when inserted after actions.
  • Do not rely on color alone — always pair the icon with text copy.
HTML
<div class="zak-result zak-result-success" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <span class="zak-result-icon" aria-hidden="true">...</svg></span>
    <h1 class="zak-result-title">Payment successful</h1>
    <p class="zak-result-text">A receipt has been emailed to you.</p>
</div>
